title: Initial handshake retransmission timer is one second
natural_language: OpenSSL DTLS 1.2 datagram、无 timer_cb override 的默认分支实际按 1000 ms arm 后，不得提前到期，并须在期限到达或被期望 flight/重设取消。
standard_excerpt: Implementations SHOULD use an initial timer value of 1 second
pointwise_semantics: strict pointwise; finite word; absolute integer milliseconds
finite_end_semantics: trace extends beyond the largest bounded obligation; missing AP=false

ap_definitions.dtls12_timer_armed_1000ms_default_profil: A non-SCTP DTLS 1.2 flight actually arms the default 1-second timer with no timer_cb override.
ap_definitions.dtls12_timer_deadline_reached: The absolute deadline for that timer generation is reached.
ap_definitions.dtls12_timer_superseded: Expected peer flight, stop_timer, or a valid duplicate-flight timer restart replaces that generation.

correlation_key: SSL object + handshake generation + message_seq range/epoch as fields
projection_rule: correlate first, then project one connection/transaction/flight; dynamic identifiers never enter AP names
instrumentation_timing: Emit trigger after next_timeout is programmed; emit fire in dtls1_handle_timeout or stop when the full expected flight advances state.
review_question: 请确认事务投影、角色条件和固定时间 profile 与实验配置一致。
limitations: ProFuzzBench's pinned TinyDTLS fork uses 2000 ms, so it is a known conformance-divergence target and is not the source oracle for this property.
independent_audit_note: Restricted to datagram/no-callback default arm and replaced callback dispatch with deadline/supersession events.

title: First retransmission doubles the next timer to two seconds
natural_language: 第一次重传后实际按 2000 ms arm 的 DTLS generation 不得提前到期，并须在期限到达或因期望/重复 flight 重启而失效。
standard_excerpt: double the value at each retransmission
time_source: RFC 6347 backoff applied to initial timer=1000 ms
pointwise_semantics: strict pointwise; finite word; absolute integer milliseconds
finite_end_semantics: trace extends beyond the largest bounded obligation; missing AP=false

ap_definitions.dtls12_timer_rearmed_2000ms: The first retransmission doubles the timeout and actually arms the next timer generation at 2000 ms.
ap_definitions.dtls12_second_deadline_reached: That exact generation reaches its absolute deadline.
ap_definitions.dtls12_second_timer_superseded: Expected next flight, duplicate previous flight, stop_timer, or explicit restart replaces the generation.

correlation_key: SSL object + handshake generation + retransmission count
projection_rule: correlate first, then project one connection/transaction/flight; dynamic identifiers never enter AP names
instrumentation_timing: Emit trigger after timeout_duration_us doubles and dtls1_start_timer programs next_timeout.
review_question: 请确认事务投影、角色条件和固定时间 profile 与实验配置一致。
limitations: Only one representative doubling is a catalog property; 4/8/16/32-second copies are duplicate obligations.
independent_audit_note: Added duplicate-flight restart/supersession and an explicit late/missing oracle.

title: Retransmission timer caps at 60 seconds
natural_language: OpenSSL profile 达到并实际按 60000 ms arm 的 capped generation 不得提前到期，并须到期或因期望/重复 flight 重启而失效。
standard_excerpt: up to no less than the RFC 6298 maximum of 60 seconds
time_source: RFC 6347 Section 4.2.4.1 and RFC 6298 minimum permitted maximum
pointwise_semantics: strict pointwise; finite word; absolute integer milliseconds
finite_end_semantics: trace extends beyond the largest bounded obligation; missing AP=false

ap_definitions.dtls12_timer_rearmed_60000ms_cap: OpenSSL clamps and actually arms the next DTLS timer generation at its 60-second profile cap.
ap_definitions.dtls12_capped_deadline_reached: That exact capped generation reaches its absolute deadline.
ap_definitions.dtls12_capped_timer_superseded: Expected/duplicate flight, stop_timer, or explicit restart replaces the generation.

correlation_key: SSL object + handshake generation + retransmission count
projection_rule: correlate first, then project one connection/transaction/flight; dynamic identifiers never enter AP names
instrumentation_timing: Record the clamp result after timeout_duration_us is limited to 60000000 and the next timer is started.
review_question: 请确认事务投影、角色条件和固定时间 profile 与实验配置一致。
limitations: The RFC wording permits a larger implementation maximum; this exact 60-second property is the OpenSSL profile, not a universal maximum.
independent_audit_note: Bound to actual 60 s rearm and added duplicate-flight/stop supersession plus missing negative.

title: Final-flight sender responds to duplicates for twice TCP MSL
natural_language: 发送最后一个 handshake flight 的端点在 2*TCP MSL（RFC 793 默认 MSL=2 分钟，即 4 分钟）内收到对端前一 flight 重传时必须重传最后 flight。
standard_excerpt: for at least twice the default MSL defined for TCP
time_source: RFC 6347 references the TCP default MSL; RFC 793 Section 3.3 defines MSL as 2 minutes
pointwise_semantics: strict pointwise; finite word; absolute integer milliseconds
finite_end_semantics: trace extends beyond the largest bounded obligation; missing AP=false

ap_definitions.dtls_final_flight_sent: Endpoint successfully sends the last flight and retains its buffered messages.
ap_definitions.dtls_peer_previous_flight_duplicate: A complete duplicate of the peer's prior handshake flight is recognized.
ap_definitions.dtls_final_flight_retransmitted: Buffered final flight is retransmitted in response in the same processing microstep.

correlation_key: SSL object + epoch + handshake generation + message_seq range
projection_rule: correlate first, then project one connection/transaction/flight; dynamic identifiers never enter AP names
instrumentation_timing: At final-flight send retain a generation marker; on repeated Finished emit duplicate and retransmission APs after retransmit succeeds.
review_question: 请确认沿用 RFC 6347 对 RFC 793 默认 MSL 的规范引用得到 240000 ms，并在论文中声明该历史版本依赖。
limitations: RFC 9293 no longer supplies a numeric MSL; this property intentionally follows RFC 6347's contemporaneous RFC 793 reference.
independent_audit_note: Rejected: same-position retransmission invented a zero-delay requirement and source did not prove 240 s state retention.
